gloss: difference in ability; gap in skill

definitions.gloss: difference in ability; gap in skill level
definitions.explanation: The gap or disparity between the actual abilities of two or more people or teams. Commonly used in sports, competition, and educational contexts.

examples.japanese: {実力差|じつりょくさ}が{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: There's a big difference in ability.

examples.japanese: {両|りょう}チームの{実力差|じつりょくさ}は{歴然|れきぜん}だった。
examples.english: The gap in skill between the two teams was obvious.

examples.japanese: {練習|れんしゅう}を{重|かさ}ねて、{少|すこ}しずつ{実力差|じつりょくさ}を{縮|ちぢ}めてきた。
examples.english: Through repeated practice, I've gradually closed the gap in ability.

notes:
FORMS:
{実力|じつりょく} (real ability, actual skill) + {差|さ} (difference, gap). The {差|さ} suffix is productive and can be attached to many nouns to express a gap or difference.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実力差|じつりょくさ}がある (there is a skill gap)
- {実力差|じつりょくさ}を{見|み}せつける (to show the difference in ability)
- {実力差|じつりょくさ}を{埋|う}める (to close the skill gap)
- {実力差|じつりょくさ}を{縮|ちぢ}める (to narrow the ability gap)
- {圧倒的|あっとうてき}な{実力差|じつりょくさ} (an overwhelming difference in ability)
